rooms.name: stonework chamber
rooms.description: You are standing in a stonework chamber, fitted with dull grey stone tiles. The room is rectangular in shape and is roughly thirty feet by fifty feet across. The only visible exit is west through a stone archway. There is a stone staircase here leading upward.
